Practice Note for Authorized Persons,
 Buildings Department      Registered Structural Engineers and     ADV-2
                            Registered Geotechnical Engineers



                             Legislation and Publications
                          Affecting the Building Industry


        A list of the legislation and other publications of interest to the building
industry is shown in Appendix A. The list is not exhaustive and is offered for general
information only.

2.          The publications listed in Appendix A are available for viewing from
various Government departments’ websites or purchase by the following means :

               calling  the  Publications  Sales  Unit  of  Information
                  Services Department (ISD) at 2537 1910;

               visiting   the   online   Government   Bookstore    at
                  http://www.gov.hk/en/residents/government/publication/
                  publication/bookstore.htm;

              downloading the order form from the ISD website at
                www.isd.gov.hk and submitting the order online or by
                  fax to 2523 7195; and

               placing   order   with   ISD   through   e-mail   to
                 puborder@isd.gov.hk.





                                                                      ( HUI Siu-wai )
                                                      Building Authority


Ref. : BD GR/1-125/2/0

This PNAP is previously known as PNAP 115
First issue     October 1985
Last revision  March 2011
This revision  November 2014 (AD/CS)  (Appendix A amended)
